page.title: Monorepo Structure
page.scope: 72 internal packages · 218 real dep edges · workspaces + build + versions
page.summary: This monorepo organizes 72 internal packages across public and enterprise (ee) workspaces, coordinated by Turbo with 10 pipeline tasks. The dependency graph contains 218 runtime import edges and 121 type-only edges, with 35 declared dependencies not yet confirmed in code scans and 21 undeclared runtime couplings that should be added to package manifests. Version management groups packages into release cohorts, while feature mappings tie packages to subsystems like omnichannel, account services, and UI components.

prose.text:
Root `package.json` declares 5 workspace glob(s):

- `apps/*`
- `packages/*`
- `ee/apps/*`
- `ee/packages/*`
- `apps/meteor/ee/server/services`

Build is orchestrated by **turbo** (10 pipeline tasks: `build-preview`, `.:build-preview-move`, `build`, `test-storybook`, `testunit`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `dev`, `dsv`, `ms`).

Sources: package.json:1
prose.narrative: The root `package.json` declares five workspace globs that organize apps and packages into public and enterprise directories. Turbo orchestrates builds across these workspaces using a 10-task pipeline including build, test, lint, typecheck, and development targets.

prose.narrative: The monorepo contains 2 main apps (meteor and uikit-playground), 55 general-purpose packages covering utilities, UI components, and core services, and 15 enterprise packages providing account, authorization, DDP streaming, omnichannel, and licensing functionality. Notable packages include apps-engine (app runtime), fuselage-ui-kit (design system components), and core-typings (shared TypeScript definitions).

prose.narrative: Of 203 declared runtime dependencies, 168 (83%) are confirmed through source code import scans. The 35 declared but undetected dependencies may be loaded dynamically or via string paths, while 21 undeclared couplings—led by models importing core-typings and federation-matrix importing logger—represent missing declarations that should be added to package.json files.

| `testunit` | `turbo run testunit` |

prose.narrative: Build scripts leverage Turbo to parallelize compilation, testing, and linting across the monorepo. Specialized commands like `build:services` filter to backend services, while `dev` and `dsv` run development and live-reload modes restricted to the meteor app and its dependencies.

prose.narrative: Packages cluster into release cohorts by semantic version. The majority follow a release-candidate (rc) versioning scheme, with the largest cohorts at 29.0.0-rc.1 (UI components) and 0.4.53-rc.1 (enterprise services), while meteor and core-typings track the development version 8.4.0-develop.

Each package maps to one or more feature subsystems or service identifiers, enabling tracing of functionality ownership. The meteor app spans omnichannel, room, and admin features; other packages map to single subsystems like `pkg:logger`, `account-service`, or `authorization-service`.
